title: Keep read-only jobs on read-only agents when they ask for the design role
action:
RED FIRST: write the failing test before the code and watch it fail for its own reason.

Slice 1 added ("design", "bee-design") to ROLE_AGENTS, so in prepare.rs the non-cell branch `pinned_agent_type(marker_role)` now hands a `--kind gather --role design` or `--kind reviewer --role design` dispatch to bee-design, an agent that writes and caps a cell. Make a non-cell dispatch whose role is design pin the read-only agent of its kind instead: gather -> bee-gather, reviewer -> bee-review; advisor keeps its current agent. `--kind cell` with role design keeps pinning bee-design (contract c86c235c). The model guard must accept each of those payloads (round-trip through the guard as the slice-1 design-pin test does).

Tests: gather + role design -> bee-gather; reviewer + role design -> bee-review; cell + role design -> bee-design (unchanged); gather + role read -> unchanged; each payload passes the model guard.
